title: Greenwich Emergency Help Points
summary: 24/7 emergency hospitals, urgent treatment centres, and local hazards across Greenwich borough.
content:
For immediate life-threatening medical emergencies, always dial 999 first.

1. 24-Hour Emergency Hospitals with A&E
- Queen Elizabeth Hospital: Stadium Road, Woolwich, SE18 4QH. From Woolwich Arsenal station: ~25 min walk south up Grand Depot Road and Ha-Ha Road, or take bus 161, 386, 486, or 178 directly to the hospital site.
- Major Trauma Centre: King's College Hospital, Denmark Hill, Camberwell, SE5 9RS. From Woolwich Arsenal or Greenwich: Southeastern train to Lewisham, then bus 185 or 484 to Denmark Hill.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres (Walk-In)
- Queen Elizabeth Urgent Treatment Centre: Stadium Road, Woolwich, SE18 4QH (collocated with A&E at hospital entrance). Open 24/7.
- Eltham Community Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Passey Place, Eltham, SE9 5DQ. From Eltham station: ~8 min walk south along Well Hall Road and Eltham High Street into Passey Place.

3. Local Area Hazard Notes
- Tidal River Thames: continuous river frontage protected by the Thames Barrier situated at Charlton; low-lying quays and riverside walks can flood during exceptional high tides.
- Low-Lying Marshland: Thamesmead and Plumstead Marshes rely on complex canal/drainage networks and carry severe surface-water ponding risks in intense storms.

4. Essential Supplies During Outages
Pharmacies and major retailers along Powis Street and Hare Street (Woolwich), Cutty Sark and Creek Road (Greenwich), and Eltham High Street supply packaged water, battery packs, and emergency first-aid goods.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
